item.title: Rockchip RK3668 Specs Leak with 44 TOPS NPU and 2027 Sampling
item.description:
A Rockchip document shared by open-hardware maker Radxa details the next-gen RK3668 general-purpose SoC: 6nm process, 6x Cortex-A725 plus 2x Cortex-A520 CPU cores, Mali G2 Pro MC4 GPU, and a self-developed NPU rated at 44 TOPS INT8 sparse compute, alongside early LPDDR6-10667 and PCIe Gen5 support. Aimed at edge AI and multimedia devices, engineering samples are slated for Q1 2027, making this a relatively long-range roadmap disclosure.

原文标题：瑞芯微 RK3668 处理器规格曝光 44 TOPS 算力预计 2027Q1 出样

Why it matters：国产边缘 AI 芯片的完整规格与路线图首次公开，44 TOPS NPU 与 LPDDR6 支持对嵌入式与端侧推理选型有参考价值。

item.title: US Commerce Tightens AI Chip Exports to Five Nations Requiring Licenses
item.description:
The US Commerce Department will require licenses for AI chip shipments to Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore and Brazil, extending controls from physical chips to rented compute in overseas data centers. The rule sets a 12 million total processing performance threshold (roughly 760 Nvidia H100s) to close the loophole used by China-headquartered firms, sending AMD and CoreWeave shares down about 5%.

原文标题：美商务部收紧 AI 芯片出口 新马泰印尼巴西需许可证

Why it matters：出口管制从硬件延伸至算力租用，直接重塑全球 AI 算力供应链与数据中心商业模式。

item.title: Nvidia Tightens AI Investment Standards on $100B Exposure
item.description:
Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress said the chipmaker will apply stricter scrutiny before funding AI companies, with roughly $100B already committed to stakes and backstops for firms including OpenAI, Anthropic and CoreWeave. Buyers without investment-grade ratings must now demonstrate solid offtake, meaning paying users for the chips they order, signaling a shift from loose ecosystem investing toward demand-anchored risk control.

原文标题：英伟达收紧 AI 投资标准 千亿美元敞口设门槛

Why it matters：英伟达对千亿美元 AI 投资敞口收紧风控，直接影响 AI 算力买方与初创企业的融资环境。

item.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Adds One-Click Cross-Device Task Migration
item.description:
Tencent's WorkBuddy now supports cross-device data migration, letting users import tasks, conversation logs, artifact files, task groups, local Skills and scheduled jobs from an old machine with one click after signing into the same account. MCP configs, logs and globally distributed content are excluded, and both devices must run the latest version.

原文标题：腾讯 WorkBuddy 支持跨设备一键迁移任务数据

Why it matters：面向 AI 工作台用户的实用数据迁移更新，降低换机成本，但属常规功能迭代。

item.title: iFixit Teardown Finds Apple HomeView Hard to Repair in Both Versions
item.description:
iFixit tore down Apple's first smart home hub, HomeView, revealing differences between the desktop and wall-mounted versions: the desktop model has a larger rear speaker and a built-in subwoofer in its base, while the wall version uses a smaller speaker and a more sealed chassis. Both are held together by heavy glue and thermal adhesive with very short cables, making the display, speakers and logic board nearly impossible to remove without damage, and the A18 chip, 8GB RAM and 64GB NAND are soldered directly to the board.

原文标题：iFixit 拆解苹果 HomeView 两款版本均难维修

Why it matters：首款苹果智能家居中枢的硬件拆解首次披露内部结构与可维修性，对关注端侧 AI 硬件形态的读者有参考价值。

item.description:

He noted that the past four years produced few closed-loop commercial successes and no landmark product, while betting embodied intelligence will outgrow the auto industry.

item.title: Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron Team Up on Robot Charging Standards
item.description:
Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron are jointly drafting unified charging standards for mobile robots inside semiconductor fabs, covering battery specs, charging-station communications, connectors and battery management systems. An early advisory group has been formed with industry bodies such as SEMI involved; the effort is framed as a step toward lights-out fabs, cutting robot procurement, validation and maintenance burdens while reducing dependence on single suppliers.

item.title: Nvidia Reassures Robotics Partners That Physical AI Investment Will Continue
item.description:
After Jensen Huang's abrupt departure and the appointment of interim CEO Colette Kress, Nvidia and its venture arm NVentures have contacted at least three portfolio robotics startups to confirm business will proceed as usual, easing concerns over its robotics investment strategy. Nvidia has invested in more than 35 robotics and physical AI companies, with 29 disclosing nearly $11 billion in total funding, including Figure AI, Skild AI and Wayve.

item.title: AMD Completes Taalas Acquisition to Fold Inference ASIC Into Accelerator Roadmap
item.description:
AMD has closed its acquisition of Taalas, a startup building dedicated AI inference chips, and plans to fold the technology into its accelerator roadmap alongside Instinct GPUs as system-level inference solutions. Taalas hard-wires AI models onto ASICs optimized for specific model workloads, trading generality for markedly higher inference efficiency. The deal fills a gap in AMD's full-stack inference portfolio and signals a long-term strategy of blending model-specific silicon with general-purpose GPUs.

原文标题：AMD 完成收购 Taalas 整合推理 ASIC 路线

Why it matters：AMD 补齐专用推理芯片拼图，模型固化 ASIC 路线与 Instinct GPU 的整合值得算力读者关注。

item.title: Anthropic Tests Linked Billing for Third-Party Claude Apps
item.description:
Anthropic launched a beta OAuth feature called Linked Billing on the Claude platform, letting third-party AI apps bind a customer's Claude organization so the customer pays directly for the API calls they generate. The mechanism replaces shared API keys, with users able to view costs, set monthly caps and unlink anytime, capped at $50 during beta. For small AI app teams, it could reshape the prepay-then-resell business model.

原文标题：Anthropic 测试关联计费 第三方应用可按需结算

Why it matters：计费与授权模式的实质性变化，直接影响第三方 AI 应用的商业化路径。

item.title: Google Signs $500M Geothermal Power Deal for 50MW from 2030
item.description:
Google has signed a power purchase agreement worth over $500 million with deep geothermal startup Quaise Energy to supply 50MW of clean electricity to its Oregon data center starting in 2030. Quaise uses millimeter-wave drilling to reach depths of 3-20km and temperatures of 300-500°C, yielding up to 10x the energy output of conventional geothermal wells. The deal marks another landmark move by a tech giant to lock in long-term baseload clean power amid AI-driven compute expansion.

原文标题：谷歌签 5 亿美元地热购电协议 2030 年起供 50MW

Why it matters：AI 数据中心能耗压力下，科技巨头以超 5 亿美元长单锁定新型地热基荷电力，是算力基础设施能源侧的重要信号。

item.title: Bosch Weighs Sale of India Tech Unit to TCS Affecting 3,000 Staff
item.description:
Bosch is in early talks to divest part of its India technology and product development operations to cut costs, with Tata Consultancy Services among potential buyers in a deal that could transfer roughly 3,000 industrial engineering staff. Negotiations remain preliminary, with a board-level discussion expected next month and neither company responding to requests for comment. The move extends a trend of multinationals selling India global capability centers to local IT services firms under multi-year service contracts.

item.title: Cerebras Deploys Disaggregated Inference Mixing GPUs and Wafer-Scale Engines
item.description:
Cerebras has moved disaggregated inference into production, assigning prompt prefill to GPUs and output decode to its wafer-scale engines, yielding five times more tokens per megawatt at the same ultrafast speeds. The setup now runs on Cerebras Inference Cloud and is available to infrastructure partners for their own datacenters, alongside CS-4 and a planned 700MW of capacity.

原文标题：Cerebras 推出 GPU 与晶圆级引擎分离式推理方案

item.title: Nvidia Invests Over $1 Billion in Kinsus to Expand ABF Substrate Output

Nvidia also amended its substrate supply agreement with Samsung Electro-Mechanics to raise existing plant throughput and reaffirmed its next-gen GPU and networking partnership with Foxconn.

item.title: Jason Wei Leaves Meta to Join Mercor as Chief Scientist
item.description:
Jason Wei, first author of the chain-of-thought paper and a former OpenAI o1 contributor, has confirmed his departure from Meta's TBD lab to become Chief Scientist at AI data company Mercor, where he will build a research team focused on data and evaluation. The move underscores data and evals as the next competitive frontier and puts Meta, which paid $14.3B for a 49% stake in Scale AI, in an awkward spot.

item.title: Bezos Advises Nvidia to Promote From Within Rather Than Hire Outside CEO
item.description:
Speaking in a Semafor interview, Jeff Bezos argued that if Jensen Huang were to step down, Nvidia should promote from within rather than bring in an outside CEO. He reasoned that Nvidia's business and organization are too complex for an external leader, whose odds of success at such companies are vanishingly small, making outside hiring a last resort.

item.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with 3D Generation Lead
item.description:
OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and the lightweight Sol simultaneously. Astra upgrades complex agent tasks, scientific research and 3D generation, topping the AA-3D leaderboard at 1318 Elo while cutting API prices 20%. Sol approaches Astra's coding ability at one-fifth the task cost, and both are available on ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.

原文标题：OpenAI 双发 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol，3D 生成登顶

Why it matters：OpenAI 双模型同发并首次在 3D 生成榜单登顶，价格与成本结构同步下调，是当日最具分量的模型发布。

item.title: 研究显示 AI 概览使外部网站点击量下降 40%
item.description:
一项随机对照实验显示，隐藏 AI 概览后，美国桌面用户点击外部网站的次数比看到概览的用户高出约 40%，说明 AI 概览正在实质性分流搜索流量。与此同时，AI 概览已覆盖 DataForSEO 追踪的过半美国关键词，而 AI 助手带来的流量占比仅 0.3%，GEO 尚未找到可验证的补偿路径。

Why it matters：用随机对照实验量化了 AI 搜索对开放网络流量的冲击，是内容生态与搜索商业模式的关键信号。

Why it matters：英伟达在管理层动荡后仍给出超预期业绩与上调指引，是算力供需与 AI 基础设施景气度的关键风向标。
